en.text: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

zhSimplified.text: 我儿啊，你要在基督耶稣的恩典上刚强起来。

zhTraditional.text: 我兒啊，你要在基督耶穌的恩典上剛強起來。

en.text: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

zhSimplified.text: 你在许多见证人面前听见我所教训的，也要交托那忠心能教导别人的人。

zhTraditional.text: 你在許多見證人面前聽見我所教訓的，也要交託那忠心能教導別人的人。

en.text: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

zhSimplified.text: 你要和我同受苦难，好像基督耶稣的精兵。

zhTraditional.text: 你要和我同受苦難，好像基督耶穌的精兵。

en.text: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

zhSimplified.text: 凡在军中当兵的，不将世务缠身，好叫那招他当兵的人喜悦。

zhTraditional.text: 凡在軍中當兵的，不將世務纏身，好叫那招他當兵的人喜悅。

en.text: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

zhSimplified.text: 人若在场上比武，非按规矩，就不能得冠冕。

zhTraditional.text: 人若在場上比武，非按規矩，就不能得冠冕。

en.text: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

zhSimplified.text: 劳力的农夫理当先得粮食。

zhTraditional.text: 勞力的農夫理當先得糧食。

en.text: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

zhSimplified.text: 我所说的话，你要思想，因为凡事主必给你聪明。

zhTraditional.text: 我所說的話，你要思想，因為凡事主必給你聰明。

en.text: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

zhSimplified.text: 你要记念耶稣基督乃是大卫的后裔，他从死里复活，正合乎我所传的福音。

zhTraditional.text: 你要記念耶穌基督乃是大衛的後裔，他從死裏復活，正合乎我所傳的福音。

en.text: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

zhSimplified.text: 我为这福音受苦难，甚至被捆绑，像犯人一样。然而 神的道却不被捆绑。

zhTraditional.text: 我為這福音受苦難，甚至被捆綁，像犯人一樣。然而上帝的道卻不被捆綁。

en.text: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我为选民凡事忍耐，叫他们也可以得着那在基督耶稣里的救恩和永远的荣耀。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我為選民凡事忍耐，叫他們也可以得着那在基督耶穌裏的救恩和永遠的榮耀。

en.text: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

zhSimplified.text: 有可信的话说： 我们若与基督同死，也必与他同活；

zhTraditional.text: 有可信的話說： 我們若與基督同死，也必與他同活；

en.text: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

zhSimplified.text: 我们若能忍耐，也必和他一同作王。 我们若不认他，他也必不认我们；

zhTraditional.text: 我們若能忍耐，也必和他一同作王。 我們若不認他，他也必不認我們；

en.text: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们纵然失信，他仍是可信的， 因为他不能背乎自己。

zhTraditional.text: 我們縱然失信，他仍是可信的， 因為他不能背乎自己。

en.text: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

zhSimplified.text: 你要使众人回想这些事，在主面前嘱咐他们：不可为言语争辩；这是没有益处的，只能败坏听见的人。

zhTraditional.text: 你要使眾人回想這些事，在主面前囑咐他們：不可為言語爭辯；這是沒有益處的，只能敗壞聽見的人。

en.text: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

zhSimplified.text: 你当竭力在 神面前得蒙喜悦，作无愧的工人，按着正意分解真理的道。

zhTraditional.text: 你當竭力在上帝面前得蒙喜悅，作無愧的工人，按着正意分解真理的道。

en.text: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

zhSimplified.text: 但要远避世俗的虚谈，因为这等人必进到更不敬虔的地步。

zhTraditional.text: 但要遠避世俗的虛談，因為這等人必進到更不敬虔的地步。

en.text: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

zhSimplified.text: 他们的话如同毒疮，越烂越大；其中有许米乃和腓理徒，

zhTraditional.text: 他們的話如同毒瘡，越爛越大；其中有許米乃和腓理徒，

en.text: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

zhSimplified.text: 他们偏离了真道，说复活的事已过，就败坏好些人的信心。

zhTraditional.text: 他們偏離了真道，說復活的事已過，就敗壞好些人的信心。

en.text: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

zhSimplified.text: 然而， 神坚固的根基立住了；上面有这印记说：「主认识谁是他的人」；又说：「凡称呼主名的人总要离开不义。」

zhTraditional.text: 然而，上帝堅固的根基立住了；上面有這印記說：「主認識誰是他的人」；又說：「凡稱呼主名的人總要離開不義。」

en.text: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

zhSimplified.text: 在大户人家，不但有金器银器，也有木器瓦器；有作为贵重的，有作为卑贱的。

zhTraditional.text: 在大戶人家，不但有金器銀器，也有木器瓦器；有作為貴重的，有作為卑賤的。

en.text: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

zhSimplified.text: 人若自洁，脱离卑贱的事，就必作贵重的器皿，成为圣洁，合乎主用，预备行各样的善事。

zhTraditional.text: 人若自潔，脫離卑賤的事，就必作貴重的器皿，成為聖潔，合乎主用，預備行各樣的善事。

en.text: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

zhSimplified.text: 你要逃避少年的私欲，同那清心祷告主的人追求公义、信德、仁爱、和平。

zhTraditional.text: 你要逃避少年的私慾，同那清心禱告主的人追求公義、信德、仁愛、和平。

en.text: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

zhSimplified.text: 惟有那愚拙无学问的辩论，总要弃绝，因为知道这等事是起争竞的。

zhTraditional.text: 惟有那愚拙無學問的辯論，總要棄絕，因為知道這等事是起爭競的。

en.text: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

zhSimplified.text: 然而主的仆人不可争竞，只要温温和和地待众人，善于教导，存心忍耐，

zhTraditional.text: 然而主的僕人不可爭競，只要溫溫和和地待眾人，善於教導，存心忍耐，

en.text: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

zhSimplified.text: 用温柔劝戒那抵挡的人；或者 神给他们悔改的心，可以明白真道，

zhTraditional.text: 用溫柔勸戒那抵擋的人；或者上帝給他們悔改的心，可以明白真道，

en.text: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

zhSimplified.text: 叫他们这已经被魔鬼任意掳去的，可以醒悟，脱离他的网罗。

zhTraditional.text: 叫他們這已經被魔鬼任意擄去的，可以醒悟，脫離他的網羅。
